title: ID0474722-DC/Si-D/SE- [Multi] Failsafemode
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Both chargers in failsafemode
Solution: Restart ocpp software

Hi,
We have had a power outage affecting all Cheap Charge Filipstad chargers. Power has now been restored to the chargers in Filipstad, however, leds were still red when the power was turned back on.
Initially, according to our backend (ChargePanel), everything looked good, and the chargers were shown as green on the online EVSE status application (ChargeFinder). However, I noticed that the chargers still showed offline status in Sifinity Control. Since then, they have lost their connection completely according to our backend and now show an EVSE status unknown in the apps.
It has been about one hour and 30 minutes since power was restored. We have also been informed by Siemens that the chargers are in failsafe mode.
Cheap Charge Filipstad chargers:
RVP/T5170004817
RVP/T5170004805
Sincerely

additional_info.subject: Sv: ID0474722-DC/Si-D/SE- [Multi] Cheap Charge Filipstad CRM:03289000369
additional_info.body:
Hi,
As I mentioned at the start, the chargers are in failsafe mode according to magnus.hellberg@siemens.com (who advised us to create the MSE case). Consequently, they appear connected in our backend even though they show as offline in Sifinity Control and display a faulted EVSE status in the apps. A hard reboot has not resolved the issue. So how can we take them out of failsafe mode? These chargers have had power restored and should not be disconnected, as the SIM cards are still functioning without issues. markus.roiha.ext@siemens.com wrote the following:
"Both chargers came back online but, in some reason, both are still in fail state. I continue investigating this and inform you when I have more information."
We have also received a photo from the site showing the charger screen, I am attaching that image.
Sincerely
Etka Kocak
